description: This file defines the JSHandle class and related functions for handling JavaScript object handles within the Playwright automation library. It includes methods for evaluating scripts, property access, serialization, and disposal, making it integral to managing JavaScript objects in browser contexts.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a JavaScript object within the page, providing methods for evaluation, property management, and serialization.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a JSHandle instance from a channel handle.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function or expression in the context of the handle.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function and returns a new handle to the result.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Gets the handle to a specific property of the object.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves all properties of the object as a map of property names to handles.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Returns the JSON value of the object.

methods.name: asElement
methods.description: Returns the element handle if the handle is an element.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the handle, freeing resources.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string preview of the handle.
